violation_type.title: Placement of Groups - Not Mingle Between Groups (26 TAC §744.1505(2))
violation_type.short_title: Placement of Groups - Not Mingle Between Groups
violation_type.typical_finding: Individual children were seen interacting freely among various groups, exiting the cafeteria, heading to the gym, departing from snack time, and joining a different group that was playing games. This was rectified during the inspection when the groups were established and the children stayed within their respective groups.

finding_variants.text: Individual children were seen interacting freely among various groups, exiting the cafeteria, heading to the gym, departing from snack time, and joining a different group that was playing games. This was rectified during the inspection when the groups were established and the children stayed within their respective groups.
The children were seen moving freely between rooms.
